title: Tile Trials
description:
Tile Trials is a tile-placing puzzle game where layouts become more complex and your tiles improve as you progress. Earn bonus points by satisfying layout constraints and pick up powerful new tiles from the market to push past the score threshold! 

100+ Level LayoutsExplore over a hundred unique layouts, designed to steadily introduce new mechanics, score challenges, and strategic opportunities. Every level is a stepping stone to mastery, rewarding your growing skills with increasingly satisfying solutions.

Six Unique Challenge TrialsChange the way you play with special challenge trials that introduce new rules and mechanics. From timed challenges to golf style scoring, these trials offer a fresh twist on the core gameplay and push you to think in new ways. 

Thirty Hand-crafted PuzzlesPuzzles are hand-crafted levels with a specific set of constraints and available tiles. Ranging from easy, deduction based solutions to hard, Sudoku-like challenges that will test your skills in achieving the maximum possible score under the harshest conditions.
description_short: Place tiles. Score big. Arrange a variety of familiar shapes onto increasingly difficult layouts to maximize your score and push past each level threshold. Evolving gameplay, mind bending challenges, and hand-crafted puzzles await!
